elements.element: Customer has no obligation to disclose to Vendor any third-party offer or its terms.

elements.element: Customer has no obligation to match or extend to Vendor any more favourable terms offered by another provider.
elements.evidence: The rendered redlined clause contains no operative language, so the original matching duty has been deleted.

elements.evidence: No MFN obligation remains, so there is no MFN that could apply beyond a defined product.

elements.evidence: No MFN obligation remains; therefore no such obligation can continue beyond 12 months.

elements.element: Any MFN obligation burdening Customer includes reasonable-comparison carve-outs for non-comparable third-party offers.

result.reason: The blank rendered clause operates as a complete deletion of Clause 7.2. This fully achieves the preferred position and, because no Customer-burdening MFN remains, also satisfies each conditional fallback limitation. The deletion is minimal because the original clause consists entirely of the disallowed MFN disclosure, matching, and pre-engagement obligations, and no unrelated commercial term is changed.
